text:
alex: Hey infra — need a quota bump + project approval for a timeboxed customer pilot in us-east4. Project ID: redwood-pilot-us-east4-prod. Requesting H100: +8 (will use 8 H100s), L4: +20, TPU v4: +4. Also need 8 external IPs for LB and a shared VPC attachment. Start target: 2026-04-01 for a 4 week pilot. Rough cost estimate ~$55k/mo.

ingrid: Can you post the project number, billing account, and a short justification (one para) so I can open the approval and support case? Also need expected sustained QPS / slot utilization.

alex: Project number: 123-456-789012. Billing acct end: ****-9876. Sustained usage: ~60% of pool during 9am-6pm PST, burst to 100% for 30-60m windows. Justification below (feel free to paste):

"We have a three-customer pilot for latency-sensitive chat/agent features that require H100 for certain heavy-context workloads and L4 for lower-cost inference. Pilot revenue potential justifies the temporary capacity; we need dedicated pools in us-east4 to meet latency SLOs and validate autoscaling policies before wider rollout."

jeff: Two quick ops notes: 1) we'll need an internal infra approval + Finance signoff for >16 GPUs. 2) I'll open the GCP support case once Ingrid files the internal request so we can link billing/org info.

jeff: Use these commands to grab current quotas and accelerator types (paste outputs into the ticket):
```
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-pilot-us-east4-prod --format=json
gcloud compute regions describe us-east4 --project=redwood-pilot-us-east4-prod --format=json
gcloud compute accelerator-types list --filter="name:('h100' OR 'l4' OR 'a100')" --project=redwood-pilot-us-east4-prod
```

alex: Pasted current quota excerpt here (copied from console):
- GPUs (h100): current limit 0, in-use 0
- GPUs (l4): current limit 4, in-use 2
- TPUs (v4): current limit 0, in-use 0
- External IPs (regional): limit 8, in-use 2

infra-bot: Reminder: quota increases over 16 GPUs require Eng Infra + Finance approval and a risk review. See internal policy: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quota-policy

maria: Finance here — temporary approvals ok for pilots but we need a cost center and PO if this goes beyond 30 days. For now we can greenlight a 30-day window provided you keep spend under $80k and provide daily burn reporting. Please add econ-code RED-PLG-2026 to the ticket.

sre-oncall: Networking checklist: will these use external LB IPs or internal only? If external, we need firewall rules, NAT / egress path, and to reserve the external IPs in the shared VPC project. Also confirm if GKE node pools are private or public.

alex: External LB IPs required for customer endpoints. GKE will be private nodes + public LB for the endpoints. We'll reserve the 8 external IPs in the shared-vpc host project. Firewall: only ports 80/443 + health-checks.

ingrid: OK I'll create the internal approval thread and escalate to Finance. Can you paste a concise justification for the GCP support case (1–2 paragraphs)? Also confirm whether we can start with L4-only (to get something up quick) and add H100 when approved.

alex: Support-case justification: 
"Customer pilot (three customers) needs low-latency inference in us-east4. L4s will serve baseline models; H100s required for heavy-context, multi-turn agent workloads to meet latency and throughput SLOs. Expected pilot duration: 4 weeks starting 2026-04-01. Requested temporary quota: 8 H100s, 20 L4s, 4 TPU v4s, plus 8 external IPs. This is time-limited and will be monitored; we will revert or reduce quotas after pilot end. Billing account: ****-9876. Project: redwood-pilot-us-east4-prod (123-456-789012)."

alex: Yes we can start with L4-only for initial validation and add H100s once quota is approved — fallback plan in place.

ingrid: Internal approval created: IR-2026-0421-87. I opened a GCP support case and linked the internal ticket. GCP case ID: 9876543210. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/9876543210 (internal). Expect response in 3-5 business days.

ingrid: Next steps: 1) Jeff — run the quota export commands and attach outputs to the GCP case. 2) Alex — add cost center RED-PLG-2026 in the case. 3) Maria — notify if you need a PO for >30d.

jeff: Will do. Attaching preliminary accelerator list and region capacity check. If GCP flags capacity constraints we may need to split across us-east4 and us-central1 (latency impact).

maria: Noted. If we exceed 30 days we'll need a short ANC (business case) and a PO. For pilot OK for 30 days.

alex: Thanks all — will update here once the support case advances. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Quick FYI — reserve the external IPs now so they don't get taken: `gcloud compute addresses create pilot-ext-1 --region=us-east4 --addresses=... --project=redwood-shared-vpc`

ingrid: Ticket IR-2026-0421-87 updated with GCP case ID and justification. Keeping this thread open for approvals.

alex: Appreciate the quick turns.

jeff: Added outputs to the support case. Case notes: requested increases H100=8, L4=20, TPU_v4=4, ExternalIPs=+6. GCP asked for customer use-case and expected burn which we provided.

alex: cool — marking this thread pending GCP reply. :raising_hand:
